name: Elton Boat Club

layers.essential_history: [[c:Elton Boat Club keeps boats on the river here. It was founded in 1973 and used a clubhouse beside the mill for 29 years before moving into a new one nearby in 2002.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:There's more history for this stop to come.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: goods once travelled by river as well as by road, which makes a quiet delivery easy to arrange.]]

puzzle_note: [[c:No puzzle here. Look out for the boats.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:From the Boat Club, make your way to the willow and the field crossing. Check the gate and the path with care, and stay on the public right of way.]]

sources.title: Elton Boat Club, Association of Nene River Clubs
